message: My wife died three weeks ago. I keep picking up the phone to call her. I don't know what to do with her clothes. Is it too soon to donate them? I feel like I'm drowning.
I'm so lonely I talk to my cat. He doesn't answer. I haven't had a real conversation in months. How do I meet people when I can't even leave the house?
Got a call from the doctor. They found something on the scan. I have to wait two weeks for the biopsy. I'm trying not to freak out but I can't eat or sleep. What do I do?
My boyfriend of five years just told me he's been cheating. With my sister. I don't know who to be angry at first. I'm just numb. How do I even start to deal with this?
I failed my final exam. Again. That's the third time. My parents are going to kill me. I'm 30 and still in college. I feel like a total failure. What's wrong with me?
My mom has dementia. She doesn't remember my name. I'm her primary caregiver and I'm exhausted. I snapped at her today. I feel so guilty. How do I cope?
I just moved to a new city for a job I hate. I know no one. I spend weekends alone in my apartment. I'm starting to wonder why I bother. Any advice?
My doctor says I need surgery. It's risky. I'm scared. I don't have anyone to drive me home or help me recover. I'm alone in this. What should I do?
I think my husband is depressed. He won't talk to me. He just sleeps all day. I feel like I'm losing him. How do I help him without losing myself?
I got fired today. I have no savings. Rent is due next week. I'm panicking. I don't know how to tell my kids. Please help me figure out what to do.
My best friend died in a car accident last month. I can't stop crying. I can't focus at work. Everyone expects me to be over it. I'm not. How long does grief last?
I'm 45 and I've never been in a relationship. I'm so lonely it hurts physically. I feel like there's something fundamentally wrong with me. Is there any hope?
They found a lump in my breast. I'm waiting for results. I'm trying to be strong for my kids but I'm terrified. I can't sleep. What can I do right now?
My daughter won't speak to me. She says I was a terrible mother. Maybe she's right. I don't know how to fix it. I'm heartbroken. Any advice?
I lost my job three months ago. I've applied to hundreds of places. Nothing. I feel worthless. My wife is losing patience. I'm scared she'll leave. What do I do?
My dog died yesterday. He was my only companion. I live alone. The silence is deafening. I don't know how to get through this. I'm just so sad.
I have chronic pain. No one believes me. Doctors think I'm exaggerating. I'm exhausted from fighting. I just want someone to listen. Any tips for dealing with unsupportive doctors?
My partner wants a divorce. We've been together 15 years. I didn't see it coming. I'm blindsided. I don't know who I am without them. How do I start over?
I'm failing my classes because I can't concentrate. My anxiety is through the roof. I've been to the counselor but it's not helping. I feel like I'm falling apart. What else can I try?
My father just passed away. We were estranged. Now I feel guilty and sad and angry all at once. I don't know how to process this. Is it normal to feel this way?
I'm a new mom and I'm struggling. I love my baby but I feel so alone. My husband works all the time. I cry every day. Is this postpartum depression? I'm scared to tell anyone.
I got rejected from my dream job. Again. I've been trying for years. I'm starting to think I'm just not good enough. How do I keep going?
My roommate moved out and now I can't afford rent. I might be homeless. I have no family to turn to. I'm so scared. What are my options?
I just found out my dad has cancer. It's terminal. They give him a few months. I'm devastated. I don't know how to be strong for him. How do I say goodbye?
I'm in a relationship but I feel completely alone. We barely talk. He's always on his phone. I've tried everything. I'm so unhappy. Should I leave?
I lost my hearing in one ear suddenly. The doctors don't know why. I'm scared it will happen to the other ear. I feel isolated. Anyone else been through this?
My sister stole my inheritance. My own family betrayed me. I'm so angry and hurt. I don't know if I can ever forgive her. How do I move on?
I've been unemployed for a year. I'm running out of money. I feel like a burden to everyone. I don't know what to do anymore. I'm desperate for help.
My boyfriend just broke up with me over text. We were together for three years. I feel worthless. I can't stop crying. How do I get through the day?
I have a chronic illness that no one can diagnose. I've been to 10 doctors. I'm losing hope. I feel like I'm invisible. Any advice for navigating the medical system?
My mom just died. I was her caregiver for 10 years. Now I don't know what to do with myself. I feel lost and empty. How do I find a new purpose?
I'm 50 and I just lost my job. Age discrimination, I think. I have no retirement savings. I'm terrified. What can I do at my age?
My husband and I are fighting constantly. The kids are suffering. I don't know if we should stay together for them or divorce. I'm so conflicted. Any insight?
I failed my driving test for the fifth time. I know it's silly but I feel like such a loser. My anxiety gets the best of me. How can I overcome this?
My best friend betrayed me. She told everyone my secret. I feel humiliated and alone. I don't know who to trust anymore. How do I heal?
I just got diagnosed with diabetes. I'm overwhelmed. I don't know how to change my whole life. I'm scared of what will happen. Where do I even start?
My son is struggling with addiction. He won't get help. I'm watching him destroy himself. I'm heartbroken and helpless. What can I do?
I'm going through menopause and I feel like I'm losing my mind. The mood swings are awful. My family doesn't understand. Is there anything that helps?
I got scammed out of my life savings. I feel so stupid. I can't tell anyone. I'm so ashamed. How do I recover from this?
My ex is getting married. I thought I was over him but I'm not. I'm devastated. I feel like I'll never find love again. How do I move on?
I have to put my mother in a nursing home. She begs me not to. I feel like I'm abandoning her. I can't stop crying. Is this the right decision?
I'm a teacher and I'm burned out. I can't face another day. I love the kids but the system is crushing me. I feel trapped. What should I do?
My wife left me. She took the kids. I only see them on weekends. I'm so lonely and I miss them terribly. How do I cope with this new life?
I just found out I can't have children. I'm devastated. My partner says it's okay but I feel broken. I don't know how to process this. Any advice?
I'm being bullied at work. My boss undermines me daily. I'm afraid to speak up. I feel small and worthless. What can I do?
My apartment building is being sold and I have to move. I can't afford anything else in this city. I'm going to lose my community. I'm so sad and scared.
I've been struggling with depression for years. Therapy and meds help a bit but I still have bad days. Today is a bad day. I just needed to say that to someone.
My grandfather just died. He was my hero. I'm supposed to give a eulogy but I can't stop crying. How do I honor him without breaking down?
I'm in debt up to my eyeballs. I can't sleep. I'm considering bankruptcy but I feel like a failure. Is there any way out?
My partner is chronically ill and I'm their caregiver. I love them but I'm so tired. I feel guilty for feeling this way. How do I take care of myself too?
I just got fired. I don't know what to do. My rent is due next week and I have no savings. Can you help me figure out unemployment benefits or something? I'm panicking.

So I've been at this job for like five years and I thought I was doing fine but my manager just told me I'm being let go due to restructuring and I'm just sitting here staring at my screen and I can't even process it. What do I do first? I feel like I'm drowning.

I have an exam in three days and I haven't studied at all because I've been so depressed and overwhelmed. Is there any way to cram effectively or should I just accept I'm going to fail? I feel so stupid.
I'm so burnt out from work. I can't sleep, I dread every morning, and I just want to quit. But I can't afford to. How do I cope? I'm crying as I type this.
My coworker keeps taking credit for my work and I finally snapped at them in a meeting. Now HR wants to talk to me. I'm terrified I'll lose my job. What should I say?
I'm a student and I'm completely out of money. My financial aid got delayed and I can't pay for food or bus fare. I don't know who to ask. Is there any emergency assistance I can apply for?
I have three major deadlines this week and I'm paralyzed. I can't start anything. I'm just staring at my to-do list. How do I get unstuck? I'm so overwhelmed.
I was laid off today. They gave me a severance but it's not much. I have a family to support. I'm trying to be strong but I'm breaking down. What are my next steps?
I failed my midterm and now I'm worried I'll fail the whole class. My parents will be so disappointed. I can't focus on studying for the final. Can you help me make a plan?
I'm a nurse and I've been working double shifts for weeks. I'm exhausted and making mistakes. I feel guilty for even thinking about calling in sick. How do I tell my boss I need a break?
My professor accused me of plagiarism and I didn't do it. I have a meeting with the dean tomorrow. I'm so scared and angry. How do I prove my innocence?
I'm drowning in credit card debt from when I was unemployed. Now I have a job but I can barely make minimum payments. I feel hopeless. Should I consolidate? I'm so stressed.
I missed a deadline for a project and my boss is furious. I had a family emergency but I didn't tell anyone because I was embarrassed. Now I might be fired. What do I do?
I quit my job because of burnout and now I regret it. I have no income and I'm applying everywhere but no responses. I feel like a failure. Any advice?
I have a huge exam tomorrow and I've been up all night crying. I can't remember anything. I'm going to fail and I don't know how to tell my parents. Please help.
I'm a grad student and I haven't left my apartment in days. I'm supposed to be writing my thesis but I can't even open my laptop. I feel like I'm wasting my life. Is this normal?
My boss yells at me in front of everyone and I just take it. Today I almost walked out. I need this job but I can't take it anymore. How do I stand up for myself without getting fired?
I just got my paycheck and after rent and bills I have $20 left. I don't know how I'll eat this week. I'm so ashamed. Are there food banks for students?
I have a paper due in 6 hours and I haven't started. I've been procrastinating because I'm so anxious. Is it better to ask for an extension or just submit something terrible? I'm freaking out.
I was fired for something I didn't do. My boss just didn't like me. I'm so angry and hurt. I don't know how to explain this in interviews. Can you help me word it?
I'm studying for the bar exam and I'm so overwhelmed. I've failed once already. I can't fail again. I'm having panic attacks. How do I manage this?
I'm a teacher and I'm completely burned out. I love my students but I can't keep doing this. I cry before work every day. Should I quit? I feel so guilty.
My group project members aren't doing anything and the deadline is in two days. I've done everything myself but I'm about to explode. How do I confront them without ruining everything?
I need to pay tuition next month and I'm short $2000. My job cut my hours. I'm considering dropping out. I feel so lost. Any options?
I'm juggling two jobs and school and I just missed an assignment deadline. I'm so exhausted I can't think. I don't know how to catch up. Please help.
My contract wasn't renewed and I'm devastated. I've been applying for months with no luck. I'm starting to think I'm unemployable. How do I stay motivated?
I have dyslexia and I'm struggling with this exam. I got accommodations but I still failed. I feel so stupid. Can you help me study differently?
I'm a software engineer and I've been on call for weeks. I'm so tired I can't code. I'm afraid I'll get fired for poor performance. How do I ask for help?
My supervisor is constantly criticizing me and I feel like I can't do anything right. I'm starting to believe them. I'm so depressed. What do I do?
I'm a single mom and I lost my job. I have no savings and my kids need food. I'm so scared. Where can I get help fast?
I have a grant proposal due tomorrow and I'm nowhere near done. I've been procrastinating because I'm afraid it's not good enough. I'm panicking. Any advice?
I got laid off and my visa depends on my job. I have 60 days to find a new one or I have to leave the country. I'm terrified. How do I handle this?
I'm preparing for the MCAT and I'm so stressed I can't eat. My practice scores are low. I feel like giving up. But I've wanted this forever. Help.
I'm a social worker and I'm overwhelmed by my caseload. I can't stop thinking about my clients. I'm not sleeping. I'm snapping at loved ones. How do I set boundaries?
My colleague sabotaged my project and now my boss thinks I'm incompetent. I have proof but I'm scared to speak up. What if it backfires?
I'm buried in student loans and I can't find a job in my field. I'm working retail and barely surviving. I feel like my degree was a waste. Any advice?
I have three exams and two papers all due next week. I'm so overwhelmed I can't start. I'm just crying. How do I prioritize?
I was let go and I'm 55. I feel like no one will hire me. I'm too young to retire but too old for tech. I'm so lost.
I'm a law student and I'm failing a class. I've never failed anything. I'm so ashamed. How do I talk to my professor about extra credit?
I'm a doctor and I'm burned out. I made a mistake last week and I can't forgive myself. I'm afraid to go back to work. What do I do?
My boss is gaslighting me and I'm starting to doubt my own memory. I'm so anxious. I don't know if I should quit or report him. Help.
I just checked my bank account and I'm overdrawn. I have no money for gas to get to work. I'm so stressed I can't think. What do I do first?
I missed the deadline to withdraw from a class and now I'm going to fail. I'm so angry at myself. Can I appeal? I can't afford to retake it.
I was fired yesterday. I haven't told my partner. I'm so ashamed. I don't know how to say it. Can you help me figure out what to do next?
I have a final tomorrow and I'm so anxious I'm shaking. I can't focus. I'm going to fail and lose my scholarship. Please help me calm down.
I'm an artist and I haven't been able to create in months. I'm burned out and broke. I feel like a failure. How do I get my spark back?
My professor humiliated me in class and I'm so angry I can't see straight. I want to drop the class but I need it to graduate. What are my options?
I'm a PhD student and my stipend isn't enough. I'm considering getting a second job but I'm already exhausted. I feel trapped. Any advice?
I have a huge work presentation tomorrow and I'm not ready. I've been procrastinating because I'm terrified of public speaking. I'm panicking. Help.
I lost my job and my health insurance. I have a chronic condition and I can't afford my meds. I'm so scared. What do I do?
